text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, six-, and nine-month treasury bills were down from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Wednesday.
Three-month bills fell to 24.38 percent from 25.01 percent, six-month bills eased to 31.22 percent from 31.30 percent, and nine-month bills edged down to 34.82 percent from 34.86 percent.
The results of Tuesday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 5.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 5.00 million UAH 23.99 million UAH
Actual amount raised 4.71 million UAH 22.58 million UAH
The central bank sold 50,000 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 38,340 were competitive and 11,660 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 9.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 8.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 6.07 million UAH 5.84 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.25 million UAH 5.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 60,665 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 44,403 were competitive and 16,262 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 9.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume 20.00 million UAH no limit stated
Amount sold 4.13 million UAH 26.95 million UAH
Actual amount raised 3.28 million UAH 21.38 million UAH
The central bank sold 41,311 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 39,361 were competitive and 1,950 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 9.
